indicators.availabilityMeaning: Whether the endpoint or provider answers: the latest technical outcome of a call. A refused password or code is the provider answering, not an outage.
indicators.freshnessMeaning: How current the data is: the last success against the integration's configured window. A reachable integration can still be stale. Unknown when no window is configured or nothing has succeeded yet.

overview.title: Integrations overview
overview.description: Every integration the platform calls, with its activation, availability, freshness and live alerts.

ssoDirectory.title: SSO and directory integration
ssoDirectory.description: The directory, single sign-on and the MFA provider used at sign-in, and the settings in effect. Settings are changed in the approved configuration and secret stores, not here.

emailExchange.title: E-mail and Exchange integration
emailExchange.description: The providers notifications are sent through: the Exchange relay and the SMS provider.
emailExchange.boundary: Notification content, recipients and delivery history belong to Notifications. This page shows the providers' technical state only.

nafath.title: Nafath integration
nafath.description: Nafath identity verification for external users: whether it is switched on here, its state and its settings.
nafath.switchedOff: Nafath verification is switched off in this environment: sign-in does not call it.

internalSystems.title: Internal-system integrations
internalSystems.description: Integrations with internal systems, registered in the catalogue beside the external providers.

apiCatalogue.title: API integration catalogue
apiCatalogue.description: Each integration's direction, kind, instances and the configuration key that names each endpoint. The endpoint itself is never shown.

detail.title: Integration detail
detail.description: Definition, instances, measures, alerts and runs. Secret values are never shown.
detail.retryPolicy: Up to {attempts} attempts, {seconds} s before the first retry, doubling each time
detail.noOperations: None: its calls are made and retried by the module that owns them.
detail.noSecrets: An endpoint is named by its configuration key. Secret values are never returned by the API or shown here.

monitoring.title: Integration monitoring
monitoring.description: Integrations that are down or stale, the alerts to handle, dead letters and runs.
monitoring.deadLettersNote: Operations that failed every permitted attempt. A dead letter stays until an operator retries it; the integration recovering does not clear it.

queue.title: Queues and dead letters
queue.note: Work each integration has not finished: attempts in flight and operations awaiting a retry, and when the oldest was first attempted. Dead letters are counted apart: they have left the queue and wait for an operator. Refreshed every 30 seconds.

alerts.title: Operational alerts
alerts.acknowledgeBody: Your name and the time are recorded. Acknowledging does not mark the integration as recovered.
alerts.resolveBody: Say what was done. A resolved alert is final; the attempts it is about stay as they were.
alerts.dismissBody: Say why no action is needed. A dismissed alert is final.

logs.title: Integration logs
logs.description: Each attempt's operation, state, failure category and codes. Provider messages are redacted by the server and payloads are not stored.

filters.malformed: This value is not in the expected format.
filters.dateBeforeStart: The end date must not be before the start date.

invocation.title: Integration attempt
invocation.sameCorrelation: Find every attempt with this correlation ID
invocation.notRetryable: This attempt cannot be retried from here: it is not the latest of its operation, or another module makes and retries it.

retry.title: Retry this operation now?
retry.body: A new attempt is made under the same lineage key and correlation ID. The attempts before it are kept as they are.

reconcile.title: Run a reconciliation?
reconcile.body: The directory is compared with the platform's copy of each person's job title, department and manager. Differences are raised as an alert; nothing is changed.

activation.enableBody: Alerts are raised again for this integration, and integration monitoring runs its operations again.
activation.disableBody: No alert is raised for this integration and integration monitoring runs none of its operations. The integration itself keeps working: sign-in and delivery go on, and their attempts are still recorded.

connectionTest.title: Test integration connection
connectionTest.intro: Connects to the directory with the service account and checks the single sign-on and Nafath providers, using the settings in effect. Nothing is changed or stored.
connectionTest.noSecret: Only the outcome and a failure code are shown for each connection. No setting or secret value is sent or displayed.

failures.UNREACHABLE: The provider could not be reached (no connection, TLS failure or time-out).
failures.BIND_REJECTED: The directory refused the service account.
failures.ISSUER_MISMATCH: The provider's issuer does not match the configured authority.

problems.permissionDenied: You do not have the integration permission this needs.
problems.alreadySucceeded: This operation already succeeded; there is nothing to retry.
problems.notRetryable: This attempt can no longer be retried: a later attempt exists or it is not waiting for one.
problems.retryNotPermitted: Another module made this attempt and retries it under its own policy.
problems.integrationDisabled: Monitoring of this integration is disabled. Enable it first.
